name: stable-diffusion.cpp
short_desc: Local image generation and editing server (CPU) with an OpenAI-compatible API
author: leejet
description: sd-server from stable-diffusion.cpp, the ggml image counterpart of llama.cpp. Runs FLUX.2, Qwen-Image, Z-Image, SD/SDXL and more from GGUF files, CPU only by default. Exposes OpenAI-compatible /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits consumed by LiteLLM, plus a built-in web UI. Defaults target FLUX.2 klein 4B.

form_fields.label: Models directory (host path)
form_fields.hint: Absolute host path holding the diffusion model, text encoder and VAE (e.g. /home/romain/models/flux2-klein-4b)

form_fields.label: Diffusion model file
form_fields.hint: File name inside the models directory

form_fields.label: CFG scale
form_fields.hint: 1.0 for FLUX.2 klein. Above 1 doubles the compute per step.

form_fields.label: CPU threads
form_fields.hint: -1 = number of physical cores. Lower it to leave room for other CPU workloads.
